players.product: enterprise PCIe Gen5 SSD controllers for hyperscaler SSDs

quarterly_data.signal: New supply contract: enterprise SSD controllers for an undisclosed overseas NAND flash memory manufacturer (FADU has performed same-type contracts with it in the past three years; name, revenue and relationship withheld at the counterparty's request for trade secrecy, disclosure deferred to 2027-05-31). PO received and contract dated 2026-10-14; term 2026-10-14 to 2027-05-31 (the end date is the product delivery date and may change in consultation with the customer); overseas supply; outsourced production; no advance payment; payment within 30 days of delivery. Amount USD 16,940,000, converted at the Seoul Money Brokerage base rate of KRW 1,340.50 on 10-14-2026; revenue base is FADU's 2025 audited consolidated revenue of KRW 92,419,333,233. If the buyer cancels it owes the lesser of 0.5% of the cancelled amount and the supplier's unavoidable direct costs; no clause exempts the counterparty from liability for non-performance.
quarterly_data.counterparty: undisclosed overseas NAND flash memory manufacturer
